paragraphs.text: Local OCR for PDFs/scans/images using macOS Vision. 本地OCR文档识别。
> Turn PDFs, scans and photos into editable text with local macOS Vision OCR — nothing is uploaded.
PDF / 扫描件 / 图片 → 可编辑文字。有文字层的 PDF 直接抽取，扫描件走 **macOS Vision 自带 OCR（中英文）**，文件不出本机。
No build step, no account, no telemetry.
Ask your agent: *"把这份扫描合同转成文字"* and it runs the OCR for you.
Text-layer PDFs are extracted directly (fast, exact); only scanned pages go through OCR. Chinese and
English are handled out of the box.

MIT — see LICENSE. Issues and PRs welcome.
Part of the hermes-skills collection.
